data.name: Dayyaan
data.gender_notes: Dayyaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is learned, knowledgeable, and wise. The name Dayyaan carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Dayyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who has gained deep understanding and wisdom through their connection with the divine
data.etymology: Dayyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayyaan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ديان
in_arabic.meaning: الله عز وجل: الحكم والفصل بين الناس بالعدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يحكم بين الناس بالعدل والإنصاف، ويفصل بينهم بالحكم الصالح، وهو من أسماء الله الجميلة التي وردت في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: دیان
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ عز وجل: حکم کرنے والا، انصاف کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ لوگوں کے درمیان انصاف اور عدالت کے ساتھ فیصلہ کرتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق عربی جڑوں سے ہے جو انصاف اور حکم کے معنی رکھتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: दियान
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह ईश्वर के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह लोगों के बीच न्याय और निष्पक्षता के साथ निर्णय लेता है, और इसका संबंध अरबी मूल से है जो न्याय और निर्णय के अर्थ रखते हैं

in_pashto.name: دیان
in_pashto.meaning: الله: د عدالت منیوالا، د قضاوت کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د الله تعالی د ښو نومونو څخه یو، چې معنی یې دا ده چې هغه د خلکو تر منځ د عدالت او انصاف سره فیصله کوي، او د هغه عربي ريښو ته اړوند دی چې د عدالت او حکم معنی لري

in_english.name: Dayyaan
in_english.meaning: The one who judges with justice and fairness
in_english.long_meaning: One of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the one who judges between people with justice and fairness, derived from Arabic roots related to justice and judgment, mentioned in Islamic tradition and the Quranic context

data.cultural_impact: The name Dayyaan holds great value in Islamic culture and tradition as it signifies intellectual depth, wisdom, and scholarship. Individuals bearing this name are celebrated and respected for their knowledge and understanding, contributing to the development of Islamic thought and theological discourse.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dayyaan carries profound spiritual significance as being wise and knowledgeable is considered a vital aspect of pleasing God by adhering to religious principles and ethical behavior. It represents the pursuit of knowledge as a means of deepening one's faith, being a vessel for divine guidance, and seeking wisdom and understanding in both this life and the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Wise, Knowledgeable" symbolizes One who is learned, knowledgeable, and wise. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Dayyaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of wise, knowledgeable.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dayyaan ibn Abi-Hadid was a prominent scholar of the 13th century. The name Dayyaan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Dayyaan ibn Abi-Hadid was a renowned Islamic scholar, jurist, and theologian. He is best known for his work 'Sharh Nahj al-Balaghah', a commentary on the sermons and letters of Imam Ali (a.s.).

trends: Dayyaan is a common name in the Middle East and North Africa.
platforms: Dayyaan is a popular name on social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dayyaan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Maryam Dayyaan from Istanbul, Turkey embodies the meaning of Dayyaan - "Wise, Knowledgeable". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
